composer.label: Message
composer.local: Runs on your home server. Nothing leaves the household.
composer.remote: Messages go to {{connection}} and the provider that runs the model.
composer.chatOnly: This model can only chat: it cannot search, read or write files, or run commands.
composer.noModel: No model is set up yet. A household admin can add one in Settings.

picker.title: Choose a model
picker.footer: Prices are per million tokens. OpenRouter lists its most used models first.

message.editHint: Sending deletes the messages after this one.

page.title: Activity
page.hint: Every tool call your assistant made for you, and whether it needed your approval. What the calls sent and received stays in the chats.

rewind.title: Send the edited message?
rewind.bodyOne: The {{count}} message after it will be deleted. This can't be undone.
rewind.bodyMany: The {{count}} messages after it will be deleted. This can't be undone.
rewind.files: Files in your workspace stay as they are.

settings.title: Settings
settings.householdNote: These settings apply to every user of the household. Only its admins see them.
settings.defaultHint: New conversations start with this model, unless a user chose a default of their own. Anyone in the household can switch models in a conversation.
settings.voiceHint: Which models turn spoken turns into text and read answers aloud. Without them, voice is off.
settings.voicePlaceholder: The voice's name, such as alloy
settings.connectionsHint: Each connection brings all of its models.
settings.removeBody: Its models leave the model list. Conversations that use one of them stop until someone chooses another model.
settings.themeHint: Follow the device, or always use one theme.

connection.title: Add a connection
connection.name: Name
connection.addressHint: Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM or LM Studio, such as http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1. Addresses on your network work only for the server's administrator.
connection.apiKeyHint: Create one at openrouter.ai, under Keys. Every OpenRouter model becomes available to the household, most used first.
connection.connectedBodyOne: {{count}} model is now in the model list.
connection.connectedBodyMany: {{count}} models are now in the model list.

reasons.timeout: The server did not answer in time
reasons.tls_untrusted: The server's certificate is not trusted
reasons.http_error: The server answered with an error
reasons.not_a_model_server: The address answers, but it is not a model server

fixes.name_not_found: This server can't find that name. Use the machine's IP address, or give it a fixed name in your router.
fixes.connection_refused: The machine answers, but no program listens on that port. Check that the model server runs and listens on the network: Ollama listens only on 127.0.0.1 unless OLLAMA_HOST is set to 0.0.0.0.
fixes.timeout: The machine may be off or asleep, or a firewall drops the connection. Check that this server can reach it.
fixes.tls_untrusted: On your home network, use http:// instead, or give the server a certificate from a trusted authority.
fixes.address_not_allowed: Only public https addresses are allowed, unless the server's administrator sets the address: requests leave from the server and must not reach your home network.
fixes.http_error: Check the address: most servers expect /v1 at the end, such as http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1.
fixes.unauthorized: Copy the key again. For OpenRouter, keys start with sk-or-, and a deleted or disabled key stops working.
fixes.not_a_model_server: Check the address: it reaches something else, such as a router's page.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.model_unavailable: The conversation's model can't be used. Choose another model in the message box, or ask a household admin to check its connection in Settings.
errors.model_request_failed: The model refused the request or failed to answer. Try again, or choose another model in the message box.
errors.model_refused: The model declined to answer this request. Rephrase your message, or choose another model in the message box. It said:
errors.sandbox_unavailable: Your workspace could not be started. Try again in a minute; if it keeps failing, tell the server's administrator.
errors.run_worker_lost: The answer was interrupted when the server restarted. Send your message again.
errors.run_timeout: The answer took too long and was stopped. Try a shorter request.
errors.internal_error: The server could not finish the answer. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the server's administrator.
errors.network: The server can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.

files.diagramFailed: This diagram could not be drawn. Its source shows what is wrong.
files.title: Files
files.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted from the workspace. This can't be undone.
files.deleteFolderBody: The folder {{name}} and everything in it will be deleted from the workspace. This can't be undone.
files.resetBody: Every file of this conversation's workspace will be deleted, uploads included. The conversation itself stays. This can't be undone.
files.empty: Nothing here yet. Attach a file to a message, or ask the assistant to make one.
files.noPreview: No preview for this kind of file. Download it to open it.
files.linkPreview: A link: it is never followed. It can be deleted.

errors.resource_conflict: Something with that name is already there.
errors.sandbox_unavailable: The workspace can't be reached now. Try again in a minute.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.hint: How your new conversations start. Each conversation can change these in its own settings.
assistant.modelHint: For your new chats, it overrides the household's default model, which applies while you choose none.
assistant.noHouseholdModel: The household has no default model
assistant.reasoningHint: How much the model thinks before it answers. Deep is slower, and costs more on paid models.
assistant.toolsHint: What the assistant may use. A tool that is off is not offered to the model.

toolNames.start_command: Start a command in the background

assistant.additionalHint: Added after the system prompt, for example how you like answers.
assistant.dangerHint: Replacing the system prompt changes who the assistant is, and can make its answers worse.
assistant.baseHint: What the model is told before the conversation. What it needs to use its tools is added after it, whatever you write.
assistant.chatHint: For this conversation, from its next answer.

voice.noMicrophone: The microphone is not available. Allow it in the browser's settings.
voice.notHeard: Your words could not be transcribed. Try again.
voice.hint: Tap the button, or press your headset's or car's next-track button, to start talking and again when you are done. After each answer, it listens again by itself.

states.listening: Listening. Tap when you are done
states.failed: Something went wrong. Tap to try again

said.code: There is a code block in the conversation.
said.table: There is a table in the conversation.
said.image: There is an image in the conversation.
said.diagram: There is a diagram in the conversation.

voice.capturing: Your voice, as it is captured

errors.unplayable: The audio the speech model sent could not be played.
errors.microphone: The microphone is not available. Allow it in the browser's settings.
errors.notRead: The answer could not be read aloud

approvals.title: Approval needed
approvals.deniedInHours: Denied in {{count}} hours unless you answer.
approvals.deniedInMinutes: Denied in {{count}} minutes unless you answer.

reasons.untrusted_content: The assistant has read content from elsewhere in this chat, such as web pages or command output, which could be trying to steer it into sending your data out. Check that this is what you asked for.
reasons.tool_default: This tool always asks before it runs.
reasons.permission: Your household's admin asked that this tool ask you before it runs.
reasons.consequential: This can't be undone, or acts in the real world, so it asks every time.
reasons.device: Calls to your devices and connected services always ask.

outcomes.refused: Turned off by your household's admin

approvals.allowedHint: What you allowed when the assistant asked. Withdraw it and it asks again.

permissions.title: Tool permissions
permissions.hint: What each user's assistant may use. Ask makes every call wait for their approval; Deny takes the tool away. Tools still ask when a chat has content from elsewhere.
permissions.byClassHint: A setting for a tool wins over these; among these, the strictest wins.
permissions.lockedByAdmin: Turned off by your household's admin
